fixed_A: Reuse R4 valid 3.825s 12-DOF result without any fixed-root reoptimization; neighboring original R1 states are references only, not optimized A solutions.
root_pivot: Original WRIST_R world position; world rotation vector [pitch,0,yaw], no roll parameter
range_rationale: X <=3 mm: <27% of 11.274 mm black-key width; Y <=5 mm: <8% of 64.866 mm black-key length; Z <=3 mm: <20% of 15.444 mm black-key height. Original wrist local envelope saved separately; these conservative research caps are not a proven naturalness threshold. Rotations capped at 2 degrees, same order as original late local orientation excursion; original total route untouched.
objective: Identical R4 skin, active/release moving surface, 7 local black keys, adjacent pairs, source joint prior; add root normalized L2 weight2. No new release target or joint-domain relaxation.
seed: Original C1 zero joint/root increments independently for each of three static states; no multistart, no choosing among outcomes.
termination_policy: Save every result and validate exact Blender skin; no parameter retuning, range expansion or rerun. Independent static samples do not establish temporal continuity.
actual_validation: E5/D5 actual pad gap <=2 mm and horizontal <=0.5 mm; local actual skin intersection witnesses and black key depth, three unchanged source cameras; no numerical success alone establishes feasibility.
